verdict: HOLD pre-tier relief pending independent root review
scope: Actual author review of retained raw, one shared RGB/float master, native half/quarter comparisons, both-axis repeats and physical witnesses. No encoded tier.
sourceMaterial: PASS author assessment: clearly recognisable matte dressed stone with coherent sedimentary lines, small natural pores and wear; five primary forms preserved. Exact geology remains an interpretation.
distanceAssessment: Both 32-square and 16-square pairs preserve the five-form pinwheel, red central square and top grey slab. Existing .65/.75 fit keeps representative colours but joint boundaries have modest position differences. Measured RGB MAE 10.3112 at half and 8.8958 at quarter is descriptive, not automatic acceptance.
repeatAssessment: Master repeats without disconnected or invented small stones. Generated dark joints are more sharply defined than native; perimeter joints and rounded arrises deserve independent review against the original repeat. No blanket seamless acceptance is claimed.
reliefFinding: All four central mortar witnesses are below the five face witnesses. However large interior face medians differ with colour: left .578, top .498, right .602, lower .570, red center .427. The red stone appears lower in scalar height; this is not proof of intended physical inset. Current plan calls for broadly coplanar faces, so stop before tiers for root assessment of whether source-bound layered mortar/face correction is needed.
